# Every OpenGL entry point the app and the vendored plx crates call through plain `extern "C"`
# declarations. On Windows each becomes an exported trampoline (src/sim/gl.rs, generated by
# build.rs) that jumps through a pointer resolved with SDL_GL_GetProcAddress once the context
# exists. Add a name here when the linker reports an unresolved gl* symbol.

glAttachShader
glBindAttribLocation
glBindBuffer

glBindTexture

glDeleteBuffers
glDeleteFramebuffers
glDeleteProgram
glDeleteShader
glDeleteTextures

glEnableVertexAttribArray
glFinish
glFlush
glFramebufferTexture2D

glGenFramebuffers
glGenTextures

glGetShaderiv
